name: Citizen Age 35 — Below OW Ceiling
scenario: Singapore Citizen, age 35, S$5,500 monthly salary, no bonus. Full CPF at 20/17% applies.

name: Citizen Age 35 — Above OW Ceiling
scenario: Singapore Citizen, age 35, S$10,000 monthly salary. CPF calculated on OW ceiling of S$8,000, not actual salary.

name: Citizen Age 35 — S$20,000 Annual Bonus (AW Ceiling)
scenario: S$8,000 monthly salary, S$20,000 annual bonus. OW ceiling S$8,000. AW ceiling = S$102,000 - (12 × S$8,000) = S$6,000. Bonus CPF on S$6,000 at 20/17%.

name: PR Year 1
scenario: PR Year 1, age 30, S$5,000 salary. Reduced CPF at 5/4% flat across all ages.

name: PR Year 2
scenario: PR Year 2, age 30, S$5,000 salary. Graduated CPF at 15/9% flat across all ages.

name: PR Year 3+
scenario: PR Year 3+, age 30, S$5,000 salary. Full CPF rates (same as citizen).

name: Citizen Turning 55 Mid-Year
scenario: Employee turns 55 during the year. Rate changes from 20/17% (≤55) to 16/15% (>55-60) in the month after birthday.

name: Mid-Month Joiner
scenario: Employee joins on 15th of month. CPF calculated on prorated salary. OW ceiling applies to full month.

expected.note: Prorated salary = S$3,000 (15 days). CPF on S$3,000 at 20/17%. OW ceiling check uses full-month ceiling S$8,000.

name: Employment Pass — No CPF
scenario: EP holder, age 35, S$10,000 salary. No CPF contributions.

name: SDL Calculation — S$5,000 Salary
scenario: Employee earns S$5,000/month. SDL = 0.25% × S$5,000 = S$12.50, capped at S$11.25.

name: CDAC Contribution — S$3,000 Salary
scenario: Chinese employee opted into CDAC, earns S$3,000/month. CDAC = 1% × S$3,000 = S$30.

name: SINDA Contribution — S$1,500 Salary
scenario: Indian employee opted into SINDA, earns S$1,500/month. SINDA = 0.5% × S$1,500 = S$7.50.
